name: Muffuletta Shooter's-Style Sandwiches

ingredients.name: hearty loaf of bread, preferably sesame-crusted

instructions.primary_message: Slice 1 to 1 1/2-inches off the top of the loaf of bread using a bread knife. Cut around the perimeter of the interior crumb, making sure not to break through the bottom crust, then use your hand to lift out the excess bread from the inside, leaving you with a hollow bread boat.

Spread half of olive salad along bottom of bread boat. Layer 1/3 or mortadella, 1/3 of sopressata, 1/3 of capicola, and 1/3 of provolone. Repeat cold cut and cheese layers 2 more times. Top with remaining olive salad and close sandwich.

Wrap sandwich tightly in aluminum foil or burtcher paper, then place in between 2 stiff cutting boards. Place a heavy weight on top (about 40 pounds), press down firmly to flatten sandwich, then let rest under the weight for at least 4 hours and up to overnight (keep an eye on the sandwich to ensure that it is pressing evenly).
When ready to eat, remove weight, slice sandwich into 4 pieces through paper or foil with a bread knife, unwrap, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: cold cut, muffuletta, New Orleans, sandwich, shooter's sandwich

description: The classic New Orleans cold cut and olive salad sandwich gets pressed for a more intense, flavorful experience.
notes: Total time, including resting: 4 hr 10 min to 10 hr 10 min.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
